clue.text: Cause of 3,18, it's been claimed - crass! Please go for treatment

indicators.note: letters sent off to be treated are worked on and come back processed into a new order

blocks.note: the two words taken letter for letter

explanation.surface: An exasperated reply to a ludicrous conspiracy theory about the cause of the 2018 Californian wildfires, telling its believer to seek help.
explanation.walkthrough: 3 and 18 are the cross-references CALIFORNIAN and WILDFIRES; a US congresswoman notoriously floated the idea that the 2018 fires were started by a laser beam from space.
explanation.definitionFit: The conspiracy theory blamed beams fired from orbit for starting the blazes, so these devices are the alleged cause.

explanation.walkthrough: 'Flaming Nora' is a mild British oath; here the flaming woman also hints at the Marjorie behind 1,4, whose theory blamed fire on a beam from space.
explanation.definitionFit: Something panoramic shows a wide sweep of view, so it describes taking in the whole broad scene at once.

clue.text: Rector charging hundred for rent

explanation.definitionFit: Rent is the old past participle of rend, meaning ripped apart, which is exactly what torn means.

clue.text: City junior left out what crook might be doing with money

clue.text: Has to move a long way back for descendants of Muhammad

far means a long way off

explanation.walkthrough: HAS rearranged gives ASH, and FAR read backwards gives RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: Ashraf is an Arabic term for the noble lineage, the people descended from the Prophet through his daughter Fatima.

clue.text: Cry of anguish during row - becoming more sensitive

explanation.definitionFit: Touchy means easily offended or delicate, so its comparative describes someone growing more sensitive.

explanation.walkthrough: DAME FOUND rearranged as UNDAMEDOF wraps round RE after its third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nobody had even dreamt of is something nobody had ever considered or imagined before.

clue.text: Carlyle maybe covering original matter

explanation.definitionFit: Ylem is the primordial substance from which, in early Big Bang theory, all the elements were supposed to have formed.

the last letter of others
